scope: Conditional phone identity supervision, weighted by teacher nonblank mass; matched training-only study with a head-fit prescreen.
hypothesis: CTC blank dominates aggregate loss but is not an acoustic silence label. Separating phone identity from alignment blank may supply useful discrimination gradients without adding an inference head.
pair_sampling: Eight pairs per training batch replace eight positive and eight TTS-negative slots, fixed seed431 pair permutations, same fixed complete windows in both arms. No original source labels are replaced by teacher classes.
advance: Require matched source schedules, first 16 training batches, representative inputs and validation exposure. Treatment must have zero continuous development events and <=1% worst engine/corpus and engine false fraction, with >=3 recall points over binary control. Use control best recall within the same strict gate, otherwise within a 2% false fraction, otherwise the zero-event control point with minimum worst-group false fraction (ties: highest recall, then lowest threshold). No final scoring or board change without promotion.
limits: 118 training-only pairs, 236 rendered windows. Offline teacher sees each complete training crop. Model-coordinate timestamps are not human phone endpoints. This experiment does not establish independent generalization, acoustic latency or P4 acceptance. CTC nonblank frames are sparse alignment events, not all voiced frames. No human speech collection or room playback in this study.
objective: The same 118-pair bank and original binary BCE in both arms. Exclude blank from teacher/student phone normalization and weight phone KL by the sum of teacher nonblank probabilities. Both arms use identical frozen-state head warmup; only treatment adds .01 times this conditional KL during joint training. The auxiliary head is discarded for the original scalar INT8 inference graph.

head_fit_gate.action: First run --phone-warmup-only --steps 0. Do not launch joint training or score validation unless this training-only head-fit gate passes and binary weights/optimizer are unchanged. This establishes fit only, not acoustic quality.
